title: GTA 6 pre-orders beat Take-Two's own forecast 📈
subject: gta6
description:
Is GTA 6 the biggest launch ever? 👇

In Take-Two's Q2 fiscal 2027 results on November 9, 2026, CEO Strauss Zelnick said GTA 6 pre-orders are tracking far in excess of initial expectations and continuing to reach unprecedented levels. Net bookings fell 18% to $1.60 billion, and Take-Two kept its full-year forecast of $8.0 to $8.2 billion. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Sources: Take-Two Q2 FY2027 earnings release (SEC, Nov 9, 2026), Yahoo Finance earnings live blog (Nov 9, 2026), Push Square (Nov 2026)
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: GTA 6 pre-orders are beating Take-Two's own forecast.
On November 9, CEO Strauss Zelnick said they're tracking far in excess of the company's initial expectations.
Zelnick added that the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough.
The quarter itself was slower. Net bookings dropped 18% to $1.60 billion, while GTA 5 keeps selling, now at around 235 million copies.
Take-Two still expects up to $8.2 billion this fiscal year, with GTA 6 arriving on November 19.
